def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = "data/biomedical/input/1-s2.0-S0092867420301070-mmc1.xlsx"
    # Load all sheets as strings to avoid type issues; keep sheet name for tracing
    xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
    frames = []
    for sh in xls.sheet_names:
        df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sh, dtype=str)
        df["_sheet"] = sh
        frames.append(df)
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

def process(mmc1):
    import pandas as pd

    df = mmc1.copy()

    # Define serous tumors using Histologic_type field (case-insensitive contains)
    hist_col = 'Histologic_type'
    age_col = 'Age'

    serous_mask = (
        df[hist_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        .str.contains('serous', na=False)
    )

    # Parse age to numeric
    ages = pd.to_numeric(df.loc[serous_mask, age_col], errors='coerce')

    avg_age = ages.mean()

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'n_serous_rows': int(serous_mask.sum()),
        'n_age_nonnull': int(ages.notna().sum()),
        'avg_age': avg_age
    }])
